Appliance Error Code Guide / LC

LCSamsung

Samsung dishwasher LC

Context

The leak-detection system has detected moisture.

Checks

  1. From a dry position, look for visible leakage; do not step into water or approach wet electrical parts.
  2. Note whether hand dishwashing liquid was used and excessive foam is visible.

Next action

Stop use and report leakage/foam to Samsung official service. Stay clear of water and electrical parts; never bypass leak detection.

Sources

  • Samsung US — dishwasher error codes ↗

Checked on 2026-10-27

← Home

Scope

Non-Waterwall rotary-spray models only. Waterwall LC can also involve its reflector and needs separate interpretation.

Applicable models
Samsung non-Waterwall rotary-spray-arm dishwashers with LC/LE display

Dishwashers
